build_starlette_app: build a Starlette app with gzip middleware and optional CORS for the fairseq inference server
create_get_pipeline: create a cached pipeline factory that reads TASK and MODEL_ID env vars to instantiate the correct pipeline
run_startup_event: run the async startup event to configure uvicorn logging and initialize the inference pipeline
refactor_allowed_tasks: refactor the ALLOWED_TASKS dictionary to add new pipeline types like automatic speech recognition
review_routes: review the Starlette routes that handle GET status checks and POST pipeline inference requests
